$comment: The work queue. Agents pull from here; the orchestrator sets owner and status. Phases run in order; tasks within a phase run in parallel on disjoint paths.

tasks.title: Design the demo game the kit must be able to build
acceptance: a one-page design: the loop, the ending, why it is worth finishing
names the kit capabilities it needs, package by package — this is the real acceptance test for the RFCs
stays under a few hundred lines of game code by design
tasks.notes: Ten gaps found and routed to the nine in-flight architects. Top three: iso path arc-length sampling (out-param), draw emissive light + night mask, sim piecewise alternating rates + closed-form depletion time.
